synchronous_commit=off requires the merged marker in the same transaction as the merge.
C2 wording: no BENCHMARK postdates #356; Kaufman wall times do. W1 2,961/s was an empty throwaway table; the only real-table band is L4 950 to 1,319/s pre-#356.
